suggested_experiment_name: Stellar cooling anomalies favored region (WD+RGB+HB, incl. SN1987A & NS CAS A)
coupling_convention: sqrt(g_ae * g_agamma) in GeV^-1 — a PRODUCT coupling, emitted exactly as plotted on the y-axis (NOT the dimensionless g_ae alone)
notes: This paper is a global fit of stellar cooling anomalies (white dwarfs, RGB, HB stars, NS) interpreted as axion emission. It reports PREFERRED (hinted) regions and best-fit values (e.g. gae = 1.6e-13 from WD+RGB, g_ae ~1.5e-13 combined), not new exclusion limits. It uses external SN1987A bounds (g_ap^2+g_an^2 < 3.6e-19) and shows IAXO/ARIADNE projections (which are other experiments' sensitivities, not this paper's own). No new observed exclusion limit or self-contained sensitivity projection is presented; the main results are model-dependent hint contours in the gae-gagamma / trkappa-fa planes. Not a haloscope DM search, so no local DM density. If a value must be recorded, the mass-independent (valid up to ~keV) best-fit axion-electron coupling is g_ae ~ 1.5-1.6e-13, but this is a hint, not a limit. | [VISION GATE D] vision notes admit tracing a compilation envelope ('union of') rather than the paper's own single curve | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: The calibration matches Figure 4 of the paper, which plots the 2-sigma FAVORED regions (colored blobs: DFSZ I green, DFSZ II cyan, A/J models brown/orange/black) of sqrt(g_ae*g_agamma) vs m_a. This is NOT a standard exclusion boundary — the region is the parameter space favored by stellar cooling anomalies, and the y-axis is a PRODUCT coupling sqrt(g_ae*g_agamma), not g_ae alone. Per the plotted-values contract, values are emitted exactly as plotted (GeV^-1 product). The traced curve is the lower envelope of the union of favored blobs; the black A/J(3,2,+1/6) blob dips lowest (~1.3e-13) near m_a~4e-3 eV. Confidence is low because (a) the plotted quantity is a product coupling not the canonical g_ae, and (b) it is a favored region rather than an exclusion limit. IAXO (solid blue) and IAXO+ (dashed purple) are projected sensitivity lines, not constraints. | Calibration: No calibration needed (spot-check verify/stage2 raw_ratio=2.12 snapped to identity) | [CONVENTION REVIEW] declared coupling convention 'sqrt(g_ae * g_agamma) in GeV^-1 — a PRODUCT coupling, emitted exactly as plotted on the y-axis (NOT the dimensionless g_ae alone)' is not canonical and has no vetted auto-conversion; needs human review
